params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Pyromania:}} '''Annie''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Pyromania'' whenever she hits an enemy with ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'' or casts her other {{tip|abilities}}, stacking up to 4 times, at which she gains ''Energized''.
params.description2: {{sbc|Energized:}} '''Annie''' empowers her next cast of ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'', ''{{ai|Incinerate|Annie}}'', or ''{{ai|Summon: Tibbers|Annie}}'' to consume all ''Pyromania'' stacks to {{tip|stun}} enemies hit for {{pp|1.25;1.5;1.75|1;6;11}} seconds.
params.description3: '''Annie''' gains maximum stacks of ''Pyromania'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]]. She will lose ''Energized'' and all ''Pyromania'' stacks upon [[death]].
params.notes:
* '''Annie''' does not lose any stacks upon entering or exiting {{tip|resurrection}}.
* Stacks are gained even if the ability is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
* ''Pyromania's'' current stacks are represented by a counter under '''Annie's''' [[health bar]], visible to all players. It lights up when the empowered effect is available.
params.tips:
* The stun applies to the first ability that lands when the stun is available. If you cast {{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}} followed by {{ai|Incinerate|Annie}} while the stun is available and ''Incinerate'' lands first, the stun will be applied through ''Incinerate''.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Annie}} spell-casts generate stacks. At maximum stacks, her next offensive spell will consume them to {{tip|stun}} the target.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' hurls a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.
params.description2: If this kills the target, ''Disintegrate's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 50% and its {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Annie}} hurls a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.
params.blurb2: If this kills the target, the {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced and the {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' releases fire in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Annie}} casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' grants herself or the target allied {{tip|champion}} and {{ui|Tibbers}} a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds and {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 50|key=%}}|movement speed}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description2: While ''Molten Shield'' is active, enemies that deal damage to it take {{as|magic damage}}. This may only occur once per enemy per cast for each active ''Molten Shield''.
params.outofrange: If targeting an ally, walk in range of the target unit to cast
params.notes:
* ''Molten Shield'' does not deal damage to {{tip|turret|turrets}} when attacked by them.
* ''Molten Shield'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.
* Attacks that are {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blind|miss}} against the shielded target will not cause the shield to deal damage, while {{tip|block|blocked}} attacks still deal damage to the attacker.
* The reaction damage does not trigger from {{cai|Noxious Trap|Teemo}} and {{cai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}.{{bug}}
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Annie}} grants herself or an allied champion—and {{ui|Tibbers}}—a {{tip|shield}} with a burst of {{sti|ms|{{as|move speed}}}}.
params.blurb2: While the shield holds, enemies who {{tip|basic attack}} it take {{as|magic damage}}.

params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' summons {{ui|Tibbers}} to the target location in a burst of flame, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies near him. ''Summon: Tibbers'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Tibbers}} is alive.
params.description3: {{ui|Tibbers}} then remains on the field as a controllable {{tip|pet}} for up to 45 seconds.
params.description5: ''Summon: Tibbers' recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Annie#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Tibbers}}.''
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|250|Summon impact radius}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|350|Tibbers' aura radius}}}}
params.outofrange: Walk in range of the target location to cast (first cast)
params.notes:
* Only the initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}<!-- and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive-->.
** Recasting the ability does, however, count as casting an ultimate ability for the purposes of {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}} and similar effects.{{bug}}
** {{pending for test}} What about {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}}?
* The active deals {{tip|area damage}}.
* Tibbers will {{tip|blink}} back next to '''Annie''' if he gets too far away.
* Recasting ''Summon: Tibbers'' does not interrupt {{sis|Recall}} channel.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' summons her bear {{ui|Tibbers}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in the area.
params.blurb3: {{ui|Tibbers}} deals {{as|magic damage}} with his attacks and also burns nearby enemies. Re-cast to direct him.
